description.value: Sonder at Revival is a design-forward, app-driven hotel in Vancouver's West End offering keyless entry and a digital concierge model in place of traditional front-desk staffing. The property sits two blocks from English Bay and delivers easy access to Stanley Park, Denman Street dining, and the city's well-developed bike lane network. It is part of the global Sonder brand, which manages approximately 9,000 units across 40+ cities and targets travellers who want stylish, self-sufficient stays.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces, covered) at 60m; stands (3 spaces) at 61m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 85m; stands (2 spaces) at 91m; stands (4 spaces) at 92m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sonder at Revival is an active, tech-forward hotel at 1771 Comox Street, West End Vancouver, with a live availability calendar and 999+ verified reviews. Luggage Storage and Fast, free WiFi are explicitly listed as amenities; the contact page corroborates the Canadian phone number (+1 438-795-6650) from OSM. No mention of bike storage, bike-specific procedures, laundry, drying areas, e-bike charging, tools, or pump anywhere in the website content, so those are null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with confirmed active listings, reviews, and availability. Useful to touring cyclists for its West End location near bike lanes, English Bay, and Denman Street amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: Sonder operates a largely self-serve model (keyless entry, digital concierge); cyclists should not assume on-site staff will be available to assist with loaded touring bikes or e-bikes. Wheelchair accessibility is explicitly listed as not available on the website.
